name: Python
description: General-purpose programming language powering web services, scripting, automation, data science, and AI systems.
p1_desc: Master core syntax, dynamic typing, algorithmic thinking, control flow, functions, and modern idioms in Python.
p2_desc: Deep dive into OOP, dunder methods, metaclasses, decorators, generators, asyncio event loops, and high-performance concurrency.

name: Java
description: Object-oriented, class-based, statically typed runtime language powering enterprise backends and Android systems.
p1_desc: Develop strong object-oriented principles, understand JVM ecosystem memory, and build robust backend Java applications.
p2_desc: Master JVM memory tuning, multithreading, concurrent collections, virtual threads, Spring Boot microservices, and design patterns.

name: C++
description: High-performance systems programming language featuring manual memory management, zero-cost abstractions, and hardware control.
p1_desc: Understand raw pointers, references, memory layouts, RAII principles, and modern C++ standard template library (STL).
p2_desc: Master move semantics, smart pointers, template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and SIMD hardware acceleration.

name: JavaScript
description: Dynamic, prototype-based, single-threaded asynchronous language powering the interactive web and node runtimes.
p1_desc: Master lexical scope, prototype chains, closures, DOM manipulation, ES6+ idioms, and asynchronous event loops.
p2_title: Deep JavaScript: Engine Internals & Async Patterns
p2_desc: Deconstruct V8 JIT compilers, call stacks, microtask queues, memory leaks, custom event emitters, and modular architecture.

name: TypeScript
description: Statically typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript, adding type safety and developer tooling.
p1_desc: Transition from JavaScript to typed applications using interfaces, generics, type narrowing, and strict compile checks.
p2_desc: Master conditional types, mapped types, template literal types, distributive unions, and building type-safe SDK libraries.

name: Go
description: Open source compiled language designed at Google for simplicity, high concurrency, and distributed cloud services.
p1_desc: Understand Go syntax, struct composition, explicit error handling, interfaces, and idiomatic CLI and network tools.
p2_desc: Architect high-throughput HTTP/gRPC services, manage channels, mutexes, context deadlines, and worker pools in Golang.

name: Rust
description: Fast, memory-efficient systems language with fearless concurrency and guaranteed memory safety without garbage collection.
p1_desc: Master Rust ownership, borrowing rules, lifetimes, pattern matching, error handling with Result/Option, and Cargo packages.
p2_desc: Build high-speed network proxies, asynchronous runtimes with Tokio, FFI native bindings, and unsafe memory primitives.

name: Kotlin
description: Modern, concise cross-platform statically typed language with seamless Java interoperability, official language for Android.
p1_desc: Master Kotlin null safety, expressive syntax, extension functions, lambdas, and modern JVM application patterns.
p2_desc: Harness structured concurrency, suspend functions, Flows, state channels, and Android Jetpack Compose integration.

name: Programming Fundamentals
description: Core computer science principles covering variables, control flow, functions, memory concepts, and algorithmic reasoning.
p1_desc: Zero-to-one guide to computational thinking, problem solving, flow control, variable scope, and clean code fundamentals.
p2_desc: Sharpen analytical thinking by decomposing complex challenges, writing pseudocode, tracing logic, and testing edge cases.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Computational foundations enabling optimized runtime complexity, memory efficiency, and technical interview success.
p1_desc: Analyze complexity with Big-O, master fundamental data structures (arrays, trees, graphs), and solve algorithmic puzzles.
p2_desc: Deep dive into memoization, tabulation, topological sorting, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, union-find, and complex algorithmic optimizations.

name: Competitive Programming
description: Fast-paced algorithmic problem solving optimizing execution time, memory bounds, and edge case correctness.
p1_desc: Master fast I/O, bitwise manipulations, modular arithmetic, coordinate compression, and Codeforces Div 2 strategies.
p2_desc: Implement persistent segment trees, Heavy-Light Decomposition (HLD), suffix arrays, and advanced contest combinatorics.

name: C# & .NET
description: Versatile, modern object-oriented language and runtime framework powering web backends, cloud microservices, and Unity games.
p1_desc: Learn modern C# 12 syntax, object-oriented architecture, LINQ queries, and building fast console and web applications.
p2_desc: Architect high-performance RESTful APIs, integrate Entity Framework Core, configure JWT authentication, and deploy to Azure.

name: Swift & iOS
description: Powerful, intuitive programming language developed by Apple for iOS, macOS, watchOS, and cross-platform apps.
p1_desc: Learn Swift syntax, optionals, structs, protocols, and build your first iOS applications with modern SwiftUI in Xcode.
p2_desc: Build production iOS apps featuring MVVM architecture, Core Data / SwiftData persistence, async network layers, and App Store readiness.

name: Shell Scripting & Bash
description: Command-line automation language enabling process orchestration, system administration, and CI/CD pipelines.
p1_desc: Automate repetitive tasks with shell scripts, variable expansions, loops, exit status checks, and cron scheduling.
p2_title: Advanced Linux CLI: Awk, Sed & Text Wrangling
p2_desc: Master regular expressions, stream editing with sed, record processing with awk, and robust error trapping in production shell pipelines.

name: Machine Learning
description: Algorithms and statistical models that discover patterns from data to execute predictive analysis and automated decisions.
p1_desc: Grasp regression, classification, clustering, evaluation metrics, and practical scikit-learn pipelines.
p2_desc: Bridge the gap between experimental Jupyter models and live inference microservices using feature stores and drift monitoring.

name: Deep Learning
description: Multi-layer artificial neural networks powering speech, vision, translation, and generative foundation models.
p1_desc: Learn forward and backpropagation, activation functions, CNNs, RNNs, and PyTorch training pipelines.
p2_desc: Deconstruct scaled dot-product attention, multi-head layers, positional encodings, encoder-decoder transformers from scratch.

name: Generative AI
description: Architectures synthesizing human-quality textual, visual, audio, and code representations through latent generative modeling.
p1_desc: Understand latent spaces, diffusion mechanisms, GANs, transformer foundations, and prompt orchestration.
p2_desc: Train and fine-tune latent diffusion pipelines (Stable Diffusion / Flux), UNet denoising, ControlNet adapters, and video synthesis.

name: Large Language Models
description: Massive autoregressive transformer architectures trained on web-scale text corpora for semantic understanding and code synthesis.
p1_desc: Deconstruct self-attention mechanics, tokenization, pretraining, LoRA fine-tuning, and RAG architectures.
p2_desc: Master parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning datasets, DPO alignment, and model quantization (GGUF/AWQ).

name: AI Agents
description: Autonomous software entities powered by LLM reasoning, equipped with long-term memory, planning loops, and external tool execution.
p1_desc: Build single-agent autonomous loops utilizing ReAct reasoning, schema-validated tool calling, dynamic web search, and structured output.
p2_desc: Architect collaborative multi-agent teams with hierarchical state graphs, human-in-the-loop approvals, and asynchronous task queues.

name: NLP
description: Computational processing, statistical parsing, semantic embedding, and contextual comprehension of human language.
p1_desc: Master tokenization, embeddings (Word2Vec), sequence transformers (BERT/GPT), and text classification.
p2_title: Modern NLP: BERT, Embeddings & Semantic Search
p2_desc: Build bi-encoder and cross-encoder sentence transformers, dense semantic search engines, and multi-lingual named entity recognizers.

name: Computer Vision
description: Algorithmic extraction of semantic meaning, bounding geometries, feature keypoints, and spatial tracking from imagery and video.
p1_desc: Learn spatial convolutions, edge detectors, OpenCV filters, YOLO object detectors, and semantic segmentation.
p2_desc: Train custom YOLOv8 / YOLOv10 object detectors, polygon instance segmentation, pose estimation, and video tracking with ByteTrack.

name: MLOps
description: Standardized practices uniting machine learning, DevOps, and data engineering to deploy, monitor, and govern production models.
p1_desc: Track experiments with MLflow, version datasets and weights with DVC, and automate model packaging in Docker containers.
p2_title: End-to-End ML Pipelines with Kubeflow & MLflow
p2_desc: Orchestrate automated retraining DAGs on Kubernetes, deploy low-latency Triton inference servers, and configure Prometheus model drift alerts.

name: Prompt Engineering
description: Systematic design and optimization of textual instructions, schemas, and in-context exemplars to maximize foundation model accuracy.
p1_desc: Master system prompt framing, Few-Shot exemplars, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, and reliable JSON structured outputs.
p2_desc: Automate prompt optimization (DSPy), write programmatic evaluation assertions (Ragas / DeepEval), and mitigate adversarial jailbreaks.

name: AI Engineering
description: Software discipline focused on building production applications by combining LLM APIs, vector databases, agents, and modern frontend/backend stacks.
p1_desc: Build web applications with OpenAI / Anthropic APIs, token stream handling, structured Pydantic outputs, and cost optimization.
p2_desc: Architect production AI products uniting React streaming chat UIs, FastAPI backends, vector similarity retrieval, and observability via LangSmith.

name: Reinforcement Learning
description: Training intelligent agents through trial-and-error interactions with simulated environments using reward function optimization.
p1_desc: Understand Markov Decision Processes, value functions, Q-Learning, epsilon-greedy exploration, and Gymnasium gym environments.
p2_desc: Implement Deep Q-Networks (DQN) with replay buffers, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and actor-critic continuous control agents.

name: Vector Databases & RAG
description: Dense high-dimensional embedding storage and approximate nearest neighbor retrieval enabling contextual augmentations for LLMs.
p1_desc: Build document question-answering systems with chunking strategies, embedding generation, ChromaDB vector indexing, and context synthesis.
p2_desc: Scale vector search with Qdrant / Pinecone, HNSW indexing graphs, BM25 + dense hybrid search, reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and cross-encoder rerankers.

name: PyTorch Deep Learning
description: Leading open-source tensor computation and automatic differentiation framework widely adopted in academic research and production AI.
p1_desc: Master tensors, CUDA device tensors, Autograd gradient computation, custom nn.Module architectures, Dataset/DataLoader pipelines, and training loops.
p2_desc: Scale multi-GPU training with DistributedDataParallel (DDP) and FSDP, export graph computations with TorchScript and ONNX, and optimize inference.

name: Web Development
description: Creation of responsive web architectures spanning frontend browsers to backend server systems and databases.
p1_desc: Build end-to-end applications uniting client interfaces, REST/GraphQL APIs, databases, and deployment.
p2_desc: Deploy low-latency web apps to Cloudflare Workers, master server-sent events (SSE), WebSocket real-time connections, and hydration.

name: Frontend Development
description: Client-facing architecture delivering responsive visual designs, accessibility, high performance, and smooth interactivity.
p1_desc: Master HTML5 semantics, modern CSS (Flexbox, Grid, Custom Properties), JavaScript DOM, and UI toolchains.
p2_desc: Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS), browser rendering performance, critical rendering paths, and micro-frontend federation.

name: Backend Development
description: Server-side business logic, API endpoints, data persistence, authentication, and secure transaction processing.
p1_desc: Construct robust web APIs, manage relational/document databases, integrate authentication, and handle async jobs.
p2_desc: Architect event-driven microservices, implement distributed locking with Redis, message streaming via RabbitMQ, and gRPC RPCs.

name: HTML5 & Semantic Web
description: Structural markup standard defining semantic document nodes, media elements, forms, and web accessibility standards.
p1_desc: Learn document anatomy, semantic landmark tags (header, nav, article), accessible form validations, and SEO metadata.
p2_desc: Deep dive into WCAG 2.2 AA compliance, ARIA live regions, keyboard navigation trapping, and accessible dynamic components.

name: Modern CSS & Responsive Design
description: Styling language controlling visual presentation, flexible box layouts, two-dimensional grids, fluid typography, and transitions.
p1_title: Modern CSS: Flexbox, Grid & Fluid Layouts
p1_desc: Master CSS specificity, box model, Flexbox one-dimensional alignment, CSS Grid two-dimensional matrices, and fluid typography.
p2_desc: Create hardware-accelerated 3D keyframe animations, responsive container queries (@container), CSS subgrid, and modern color spaces.

name: React
description: Component-driven declarative frontend library for constructing reactive, fast, and scalable user interfaces.
p1_desc: Master JSX, functional components, hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo), state managers, and routing.
p2_desc: Master React Server Components (RSC), useActionState, useOptimistic, transitions, compiler optimizations, and atomic state.

name: Next.js Full Stack
description: Production React framework offering hybrid static/server rendering, TypeScript support, smart bundling, and route handlers.
p1_desc: Learn Next.js 15 App Router conventions, layouts, nested routing, Server Actions, image optimization, and dynamic SEO metadata.
p2_desc: Build multi-tenant SaaS architectures, configure middleware authentication, edge caching with ISR, and deploy to Vercel/AWS.

name: FastAPI
description: High-performance Python asynchronous web framework based on OpenAPI standards, type hints, and Starlette/Pydantic.
p1_desc: Build high-throughput REST APIs, define Pydantic validation schemas, and integrate async SQLAlchemy.
p2_desc: Architect production microservices featuring JWT OAuth2 authentication, Redis caching, Celery task queues, and async testing.

name: Django Web Framework
description: Batteries-included high-level Python web framework encouraging rapid development and clean, pragmatic design.
p1_desc: Master Model-View-Template (MVT) architecture, Django ORM relational queries, migrations, built-in authentication, and admin panel.
p2_desc: Construct production REST APIs with DRF, ModelSerializers, viewsets, token authentication, Celery async tasks, and caching.

name: Node.js & Serverless
description: V8 asynchronous event-driven JavaScript runtime environment enabling scalable server backends and serverless functions.
p1_desc: Understand Node runtime internals, CommonJS/ES modules, asynchronous file I/O, event emitters, streams, and HTTP servers.
p2_desc: Build event-driven serverless architectures with AWS Lambda / Vercel Serverless, cold-start optimization, and SQS queue processing.

name: Full Stack Development
description: Comprehensive engineering proficiency uniting client UI, server backends, database layers, DevOps, and cloud deployment.
p1_desc: Build cohesive end-to-end applications pairing React frontend components with Node/Express backends and PostgreSQL databases.
p2_desc: Architect enterprise SaaS platforms with multi-tenancy, Stripe payment billing, role-based access control, and automated CI/CD.

name: Tailwind CSS
description: Utility-first CSS framework packed with classes that can be composed to build any design directly in your markup.
p1_desc: Accelerate UI development with utility classes, responsive breakpoints, flexbox/grid shortcuts, and dark mode toggles.
p2_title: Tailwind Design Systems & Custom UI Kits
p2_desc: Extend Tailwind config tokens, build accessible reusable component libraries, configure typography/forms plugins, and use Tailwind v4.

name: Express.js REST APIs
description: Fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework for Node.js providing a robust set of features for web and mobile APIs.
p1_desc: Structure clean REST APIs with modular Express routers, middleware logging, input validation with Zod, and CORS security.
p2_desc: Harden Express backends with Helmet security headers, rate limiters, JWT token verification, and integration with Prisma ORM.

name: GraphQL & Modern APIs
description: Query language for APIs and runtime for fulfilling queries with existing data, enabling clients to request exactly what they need.
p1_desc: Understand GraphQL type systems, write expressive queries and mutations, build schemas, and implement resolver functions.
p2_desc: Architect federated GraphQL subgraphs, solve N+1 query problems with DataLoader, implement real-time subscriptions, and secure endpoints.

name: Cyber Security
description: Protection of networks, cloud infrastructures, software programs, and sensitive data from adversary cyber intrusions.
p1_desc: Understand network security, penetration testing basics, cryptography, security hygiene, and defensive operations.
p2_desc: Architect enterprise defense architectures, segment network zones, implement Zero Trust models, and establish NIST compliance.

name: Ethical Hacking
description: Authorized probing and vulnerability discovery to identify security flaws before malicious threat actors exploit them.
p1_desc: Learn Kali Linux utilities, reconnaissance with Nmap/Shodan, vulnerability scanning, and exploitation with Metasploit.
p2_desc: Tackle vulnerable machines on HackTheBox / TryHackMe, write custom buffer overflow exploits, and pivot through internal subnets.

name: Network Security
description: Implementation of hardware and software protocols protecting computer network infrastructure against unauthorized access and tampering.
p1_desc: Understand TCP/IP 3-way handshakes, capture network packets with Wireshark, analyze DNS/HTTP traffic, and identify spoofing.
p1_concepts: arp spoofing & man in the middle
p2_desc: Configure stateful firewalls (iptables/pfSense), WireGuard VPN tunnels, Snort intrusion detection (IDS), and 802.1X network access control.

name: Web Security & OWASP
description: Protection of web applications, REST/GraphQL APIs, and browser sessions against common cyber vulnerabilities.
p1_desc: Explore SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), CSRF, SSRF, broken access controls using Burp Suite community edition.
p2_desc: Find severe web flaws: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), JWT tampering, Insecure Deserialization, race conditions, and OAuth flaws.

name: Linux Security & Hardening
description: Configuring, auditing, and enforcing security policies across Linux operating systems, user privileges, and server daemons.
p1_desc: Secure Linux servers: disable root login, configure SSH key pairs, set strict chmod/chown permissions, and deploy UFW firewall and Fail2ban.
p2_desc: Configure Mandatory Access Control (MAC) with SELinux and AppArmor, audit system logs with auditd, and tune kernel sysctl parameters.

name: Cyber Fundamentals
description: Essential foundational concepts in cyber threats, authentication, password management, social engineering, and safe computing.
p1_desc: Demystify cyber attacks: phishing recognition, multi-factor authentication (MFA), password vaults, ransomware, and digital footprints.
p2_desc: Understand how security teams triage alerts, evaluate indicators of compromise (IoCs), and respond to credential leaks.

name: Penetration Testing
description: Structured methodology for simulating real-world cyber adversary attacks against corporate infrastructure and Active Directory domains.
p1_desc: Master standardized penetration testing lifecycles: scope agreements, passive OSINT, network vulnerability verification, and reporting.
p2_desc: Infiltrate Windows enterprise environments: Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, BloodHound attack graphs, pass-the-hash, and Golden Tickets.

name: Cryptography & Encryption
description: Mathematical primitives for securing confidential information, verifying identity, and guaranteeing data tamper resistance.
p1_desc: Understand symmetric ciphers (AES-GCM), asymmetric key pairs (RSA, ECC), cryptographic hashing (SHA-256), and SSL/TLS certificates.
p2_desc: Explore post-quantum lattice cryptography (Kyber/Dilithium), Zero-Knowledge Proofs (zk-SNARKs), and homomorphic encryption.

name: Cloud Security & DevSecOps
description: Embedding automated security controls, policy compliance, and vulnerability scanners across cloud environments and CI/CD pipelines.
p1_desc: Harden cloud deployments: configure least-privilege IAM policies, secure AWS S3 buckets, enable CloudTrail auditing, and deploy GuardDuty.
p2_desc: Integrate automated security gates in GitHub Actions: static code analysis (SonarQube), container vulnerability scanning (Trivy), and IaC scanning (Checkov).

name: Incident Response & SOC Analysis
description: Real-time cyber threat monitoring, log correlation across SIEMs, forensic artifact extraction, and containment playbooks.
p1_desc: Master Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows: analyze Windows Event logs, write Splunk/Elasticsearch search queries, and triage alerts.
p2_desc: Perform dead-box disk forensics (Autopsy/FTK), volatility RAM memory analysis, timeline creation, and root cause reporting.

name: Malware Analysis & Reverse Engineering
description: Decompiling and dissecting malicious executables in isolated sandbox environments to extract signatures and understand behavior.
p1_desc: Setup safe sandbox analysis labs, perform static analysis (PE headers, strings, import tables), dynamic detonation with Process Monitor, and YARA rules.
p2_desc: Disassemble compiled malware binaries using Ghidra and x64dbg, bypass anti-analysis defenses, unpack payload drops, and deobfuscate C2 strings.

name: Identity & Access Management (IAM)
description: Framework of business processes, policies, and technologies facilitating the management of digital user identities and access rights.
p1_desc: Understand authentication vs authorization, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
p2_desc: Implement OAuth 2.0 authorization code flows with PKCE, OpenID Connect identity tokens, SAML federation, and Okta/Keycloak server setups.

name: Cloud Computing
description: On-demand availability of computational power, relational storage, and managed services over the Internet with pay-as-you-go pricing.
p1_desc: Understand cloud service models (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS), AWS/GCP/Azure primitives, IAM, VPCs, and serverless architectures.
p2_desc: Design fault-tolerant architectures across multiple cloud providers, hybrid-cloud connectivity, and cloud financial operations (FinOps).

name: Git & GitHub
description: Distributed version control system tracking source code modifications and enabling team collaboration across software branches.
p1_desc: Master branch workflows, merges, rebases, pull requests, resolving merge conflicts, and GitHub collaboration.
p2_desc: Master interactive rebasing (git rebase -i), git bisect bug localization, reflog disaster recovery, submodules, and trunk-based development.

name: DevOps
description: Organizational culture and engineering practices uniting software development and IT operations to shorten deployment lifecycles.
p1_desc: Learn containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, CI/CD automated deployment, and IaC.
p2_desc: Implement Google SRE methodologies: Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Error Budgets, incident command structures, and blameless postmortems.

name: AWS (Amazon Web Services)
description: Comprehensive, widely adopted cloud computing platform offering over 200 fully featured services from global data centers.
p1_desc: Prepare for AWS Certified Solutions Architect: compute (EC2), storage (S3/EBS), databases (RDS), security (IAM), and networking (VPC).
p2_desc: Build scalable serverless systems using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB single-table design, EventBridge, and Step Functions.

name: Microsoft Azure
description: Microsoft's public cloud computing platform providing scalable enterprise infrastructure, hybrid connectivity, and AI services.
p1_desc: Master Microsoft Azure core concepts: Resource Groups, Virtual Machines, Azure Blob Storage, Azure SQL, and Entra ID (Azure AD).
p2_desc: Design enterprise Azure solutions with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Services, Azure Front Door, ExpressRoute, and Bicep IaC.

name: Docker Containerization
description: Open platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in lightweight, isolated operating system containers.
p1_desc: Understand container isolation, write Dockerfiles, build efficient images, manage persistent volumes, and run multi-container Docker Compose.
p2_desc: Reduce image sizes using Alpine/distroless, multi-stage compilation builds, rootless daemon security, and BuildKit caching.

name: Kubernetes Orchestration
description: Production-grade, open-source container orchestration system for automating application deployment, scaling, and management.
p1_desc: Master core Kubernetes abstractions: Pods, ReplicaSets, Deployments, Services (ClusterIP, NodePort), Ingress controllers, and kubectl.
p2_desc: Package cloud apps with Helm charts, configure cert-manager TLS Ingress, implement Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA), and ArgoCD GitOps.

name: CI/CD Pipelines & Automation
description: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines automating code builds, test execution, artifact publishing, and cloud deploys.
p1_desc: Write automated GitHub Actions YAML workflows: trigger on pull requests, run linting/testing matrixes, and build Docker containers.
p2_desc: Implement declarative continuous delivery with GitOps, blue-green deployments, canary releases using Flagger, and automated rollback.

name: Linux Administration
description: Operating system administration managing Linux kernels, file systems, daemon services, user permissions, and network sockets.
p1_desc: Master Linux file hierarchies, file permissions (chmod/chown), process monitoring (top/htop/ps), systemd service management, and SSH access.
p2_desc: Diagnose server bottlenecks using vmstat, iostat, and strace; tune kernel parameters in /proc; manage LVM volumes and RAID storage.

name: Terraform & Infrastructure as Code
description: Declarative provisioning and lifecycle management of multi-cloud infrastructure using HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL).
p1_desc: Write declarative HCL configurations, manage Terraform providers (AWS/Azure), inspect terraform plan outputs, and modularize code.
p2_desc: Manage remote S3 state with DynamoDB state locking, DRY multi-environment infrastructure with Terragrunt, and policy checks via Sentinel.

name: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
description: Google's suite of modular cloud services for scalable container execution, BigQuery analytics, and machine learning infrastructure.
p1_title: Google Cloud Platform Associate Cloud Engineer
p1_desc: Understand GCP core infrastructure: Compute Engine instances, Cloud Storage buckets, Cloud Run serverless containers, and IAM hierarchy.
p2_desc: Scale big data analytical queries with BigQuery, stream event data with Cloud Pub/Sub, and train models using Vertex AI pipelines.

name: Observability, Prometheus & Grafana
description: Collection, visualization, and alerting across distributed application metrics, structured logs, and distributed traces.
p1_desc: Understand the 3 pillars of observability, scrape application endpoints with Prometheus, and build visual Grafana dashboards.
p2_desc: Instrument microservices with OpenTelemetry (OTel), collect distributed traces in Jaeger, and aggregate log streams with Grafana Loki.

name: Microservices Architecture
description: Architectural approach designing applications as collections of small, loosely coupled, independently deployable services.
p1_desc: Decompose monoliths using Domain-Driven Design (DDD), configure API Gateways, manage database-per-service, and implement the Saga pattern.
p2_title: Service Mesh Architecture with Istio & Envoy
p2_desc: Deploy Istio service mesh on Kubernetes, configure Envoy sidecar proxies, mutual TLS (mTLS) zero-trust, and dynamic traffic canary routing.

name: Data Science
description: Interdisciplinary extraction of actionable insights from structured and unstructured data using mathematics, statistics, and programming.
p1_desc: Wrangle complex datasets, conduct statistical hypotheses, create informative visualizations, and build models.
p2_title: Applied Machine Learning for Data Scientists
p2_desc: Build production XGBoost/LightGBM tabular pipelines, hyperparameter search via Optuna, SHAP interpretability, and business KPI modeling.

name: Data Analytics
description: Examination, transformation, and modeling of data to uncover operational patterns, executive conclusions, and commercial opportunities.
p1_desc: Master SQL querying, business intelligence dashboards (Tableau/PowerBI), spreadsheet modeling, and storytelling.
p2_desc: Build automated customer retention cohort matrices, executive OKR tracking dashboards, and causal analytics models.

name: SQL & Databases
description: Relational algebra and structured querying language managing tabular data storage, ACID transactions, and aggregations.
p1_desc: Master relational schema normalization, indexing, joins, aggregate analytical functions, and ACID.
p2_title: Advanced SQL: Window Functions & Query Optimization
p2_desc: Master window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG/LEAD), recursive CTEs, query execution plans (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), and index strategies.

name: Database Engineering & Modeling
description: Architectural design of high-throughput data schemas, relational normal forms, NoSQL access patterns, and distributed replication.
p1_desc: Design normalized 3NF schemas, draw ER diagrams, evaluate relational vs document trade-offs, and design high-scale key-value access patterns.
p2_desc: Architect primary-replica replication, Raft consensus, horizontal sharding, connection pooling with PgBouncer, and disaster recovery.

name: Statistics
description: Mathematical science of collecting, analyzing, presenting, and deducing properties from numeric data distributions.
p1_desc: Understand probability distributions, Central Limit Theorem, hypothesis testing, p-values, and Bayesian inference.
p2_desc: Master Bayesian priors and posteriors, Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), sample size calculations, and multi-armed bandit experimentation.

name: Data Visualization & Storytelling
description: Visual translation of complex numeric findings into intuitive charts, spatial heatmaps, and executive presentation dashboards.
p1_desc: Create publication-ready visual figures with Seaborn and Plotly, selecting chart types, color palettes, and interactive tooltips.
p2_desc: Build live web dashboards with Streamlit and Dash, connecting real-time database feeds, dynamic filtering, and visual scrollytelling.

name: Big Data & Distributed Computing
description: Distributed computational frameworks processing terabyte-to-petabyte datasets across parallel worker clusters.
p1_title: Big Data Foundations with Hadoop & Spark
p1_desc: Understand cluster computing architectures, HDFS distributed storage, PySpark DataFrame operations, and resilient distributed datasets (RDDs).
p2_title: Real-Time Stream Processing with Kafka & Flink
p2_desc: Architect event streams using Apache Kafka topics, consumer groups, exactly-once semantics, and Apache Flink stateful windowing.

name: Data Engineering
description: Design and maintenance of robust automated pipelines, data warehouses, and lakes delivering clean data across organizations.
p1_desc: Design automated ETL/ELT pipelines, extract raw API feeds, transform data with Pandas/SQL, and write Parquet data lake files.
p2_title: Modern Data Stack: dbt, Airflow & Data Lakes
p2_desc: Orchestrate DAGs using Apache Airflow, build modular transformation models with dbt, and manage Delta Lake ACID tables.

name: PostgreSQL Administration & Optimization
description: Enterprise-grade open source object-relational database system known for reliability, feature robustness, and SQL compliance.
p1_desc: Manage PostgreSQL servers, configure postgresql.conf, create specialized indexes (B-Tree, GIN, GiST), and run VACUUM maintenance.
p2_desc: Implement declarative table partitioning, Citus distributed clustering, zero-downtime schema migrations, and connection pooling.

name: MongoDB & NoSQL Systems
description: Document-oriented NoSQL database system utilizing flexible JSON-like documents with dynamic schemas.
p1_desc: Model nested BSON documents, perform CRUD operations with Compass, build compound indexes, and link with Mongoose ODM.
p2_desc: Master multi-stage aggregation pipelines ($match, $group, $lookup, $unwind), replica set elections, and horizontal shard keys.

name: Business Intelligence & Power BI
description: Interactive data visualization and business analytics platform translating diverse enterprise data streams into executive dashboards.
p1_desc: Transform data using Power Query M, design Star Schemas with 1-to-many relationships, and write calculated DAX measures (CALCULATE, FILTER).
p2_desc: Implement Row-Level Security (RLS), incremental dataset refresh, Power BI service workspaces, paginated reports, and CI/CD pipelines.

name: Pandas & Scientific Python
description: High-performance Python libraries for data manipulation, vectorized numeric array operations, and tabular data science.
